name: Subarashii
summary: Subarashii is the second entry in the SUGOI series, a series of collaborative level packs created by community members under the supervision of TehRealSalt. It contains 48 levels created over the course of December 2016 and features work by more than 60 different contributors. In addition to regular levels, this edition of Sugoi also asked mappers to create their own Special Stages. As a result, Subarashii includes seven Special Stages, each of which utilizes Lua scripts to create its own unique playstyle. The level pack was initially released on July 27th, 2017.
